reports.phase: Initial boot without edits or SAVE
reports.scope: Japanese list/order, two ROM launches/video/audio/controls, STAGE5E/SAVE row, Dr.Mario CSV ON/WEAK/STANDARD and Pac-Man DEFAULT all OFF, IDs/SAVE RECOMMENDED/STORE MISSING/FRAME ACK, X/Y exit and OSD1 return

reports.phase: Preview discard, explicit SAVE and relaunch
reports.scope: X discards unsaved live preview to CSV baseline; SAVE of ON/STRONG/STRONG stays open with SAVED/FRAME ACK; Y discards later edits back to saved value; relaunch restores USER/SAVED/STORE USER; Pac-Man remains DEFAULT/OFF/MISSING/RECOMMENDED

reports.phase: Power cycle, repeated SAVE, second game and explicit OFF, OSD regression
reports.scope: Normal power cycle restores Dr.Mario STRONG/STRONG; Dr.Mario STANDARD/WEAK SAVE and unchanged repeat SAVE/relaunch normal; Pac-Man WEAK/STANDARD then explicit all-OFF SAVE/relaunch USER normal without changing Dr.Mario; five positions, exclusion/centering, input block/release normal

reports.user_report: PCで読んだ値になるよう追加・変更して保存した
reports.scope: Observed Dr.Mario latest generation4 ON/WEAK/STANDARD and Pac-Man historical settings reflect additional user saves; previous sequence mismatch is explained without modifying stored bytes

reports.phase: Read-only SAVE failure, retry and X/Y discard
reports.scope: Dr.Mario baseline USER ON/WEAK/STANDARD loads normally; changed SAVE remains open with FAILED, retry remains FAILED; X and Y each restore baseline video/values; relaunch preserves baseline with USER/SAVED/FRAME ACK and normal video/audio/controls

limitations: Read-only denied-write behavior, retry and X/Y discard are hardware-confirmed. Post-failure SD integrity/attribute restoration and successful saving after recovery remain pending. Controlled same-value generation proof also pending. Other fault classes are host-tested; Reset/defaults excluded.
